relations: Hands pressing the silver sphere against the red container rotate it between fingers.
The container moves right away, leaving the sphere held alone and rotated gently.
The other hand returns to close around the sphere together.
An arm extends toward the top right, resting on the plastic bag beside the spheres.
caption: The video depicts an overhead view of a white table holding a cluster of red cylindrical magnets, a labeled white box on the left, and a clear bag of silver magnetic spheres at the top right. A person in a grey long-sleeved shirt holds a single silver sphere in one hand and a small red container in the other. The two are pressed together and turned between the fingers. The hands then separate as the container is moved away to the right, leaving the sphere held alone and rotated gently. After a moment the other hand returns, and both hands close around the sphere together. One arm then extends toward the top right, and the hand reaches the plastic bag, resting on it beside the string of spheres.
